multiSurfaceScope.sliceContract: all 24 journey slices are integrated in every stage

checks.proves: Field runtime and imported identity/workforce/readiness bindings type-check.
checks.doesNotProve: Type checking does not prove server authorization or native behavior.

checks.proves: Operational capability bindings remain connected across shared brains and surfaces.
checks.doesNotProve: It does not prove every identity abuse case unless assertions cover them.
